draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) suggest that salience pre-filtering may help reduce unsupported entities in summaries.
rationale: P1 describes the pre-filtering method (scoring, threshold 0.35, training data) but says nothing about unsupported entities or hallucination reduction. The attribution to Varga & Sandoval (2021) is unsupported. The package's own exp1/cmp2 shows the re-implementation reduced hallucination, but that is not attributable to the cited work.
